dogecoin.text: There are people who are millionaires or bought their houses because of #dogecoin . Reading stories about W's like that is good for the soul. The nature of Twitter is that it's snarky and cynical, but it's always better to have an abundance mindset instead of a scarcity mindset.

Broke: Elon Musk throws a few billion dollars to the UN so they can waste it.
Woke: Elon Musk funds a movement to restore the Kaiser on the condition the new German Empire uses dogecoin.
